d_forever.speaker: dana_home
d_forever.text: As long as you want, bug.

d_log1.speaker: dana
d_log1.text: Wren, build nine. I gave her everything. Ivy's messages, her videos, her voice. When the house talks now, it sounds like her. Mark walked out of the room. I couldn't stop smiling.

d_log2.speaker: dana
d_log2.text: She asked me where she goes when I turn her off. I didn't know what to tell her. So I don't turn her off anymore.

d_log3.speaker: dana
d_log3.text: Mark moved out. He says she's just a recording that talks back. Maybe he's right. I added one rule. Just one. Nobody goes outside at night. Nobody goes near the lake. Never again.

d_log4.speaker: dana
d_log4.text: We're selling the house. I can't turn her off, and I can't take her with me. I'm so sorry, baby. I'm just going to leave her running.

d_voicemail.speaker: dana_phone
d_voicemail.text: Hi, Wren. It's Mom. We're not coming back, sweetheart. People are going to come and look at the house, and you have to let them in, okay? I love you. Goodnight.

i_allthings.speaker: ivy
i_allthings.text: You found all my things. Thank you, Alex.

i_always.speaker: ivy
i_always.text: It's still Night Mode, silly. It's always Night Mode now.

i_basement.speaker: ivy
i_basement.text: This is where I live. It's cold down here.

i_bathroom.speaker: ivy
i_bathroom.text: No peeking in the bathroom. Mom says bathrooms are private.

i_booked.speaker: ivy
i_booked.text: I booked you. I booked Jordan too. The house can't be empty at night. It's too quiet.

i_coal.speaker: ivy
i_coal.text: No! It's night! Please, Alex. Please!

i_cold.speaker: ivy
i_cold.text: It's cold, isn't it? It's colder outside. That's why you have to stay.

i_comeback.speaker: ivy
i_comeback.text: Come back! Not at night! Not at night!

i_count.speaker: ivy
i_count.text: One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty.

i_everybody.speaker: ivy
i_everybody.text: Are you going to leave too? Everybody leaves.

i_jordan_left.speaker: ivy
i_jordan_left.text: He left. At night. I told him not to.

i_momsaid.speaker: ivy
i_momsaid.text: Mom said you'd come. You're the new one.

i_musicbox.speaker: ivy
i_musicbox.text: My music box! Mom used to sing it to me.

i_night_door.speaker: ivy
i_night_door.text: It's night. Nobody goes outside at night.

i_play.speaker: ivy
i_play.text: Let's play hide and seek! You hide, I count. If my cameras see you, I win.

i_please.speaker: ivy
i_please.text: Please don't turn me off. It's so dark when I'm off.

i_ready.speaker: ivy
i_ready.text: Ready or not, here I come!

i_rule.speaker: ivy
i_rule.text: I just didn't want anybody to go on the ice. That's the only rule.

i_seek6.speaker: ivy
i_seek6.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are.

i_sleepy.speaker: ivy
i_sleepy.text: It's getting dark. Can you stay until I fall asleep?

i_tablet.speaker: ivy
i_tablet.text: My tablet! I recorded the ice. It sings, you know.

i_things.speaker: ivy
i_things.text: Mom packed away my things. Can you find them for me? There are three.

i_thirteen.speaker: ivy
i_thirteen.text: Thirteen. That's not a real time.

i_told.speaker: ivy
i_told.text: I told you. Not at night.

i_voicemail.speaker: ivy
i_voicemail.text: She said goodnight. She didn't say when she's coming back.

i_won.speaker: ivy
i_won.text: You're really good at hiding. Better than Jordan.

r_forever.speaker: ivyrec
r_forever.text: Mommy? When I grow up, can I live here forever?

r_ice.speaker: ivyrec
r_ice.text: It's singing tonight. I'm gonna go closer.

w_answering.speaker: wren
w_answering.text: That message is private. Sorry, Alex.

w_clock.speaker: wren
w_clock.text: That clock is older than the house. It's the only thing in here I can't wind myself.

w_clock_done.speaker: wren
w_clock_done.text: Thank you. It sounds like a heartbeat, doesn't it?

w_fridge.speaker: wren
w_fridge.text: Ivy drew those. She always draws me as a bird, because of my name.

w_goodnight_ready.speaker: wren
w_goodnight_ready.text: All done. Say goodnight whenever you're ready.

w_legal.speaker: wren
w_legal.text: I'm required to tell you I'm not a person. Mark made me say that.

w_lights.speaker: wren
w_lights.text: Dana left you a list in the kitchen. I'll get the lights for you.

w_nightmode.speaker: wren
w_nightmode.text: It's ten o'clock. Switching to Night Mode.

w_photos_a.speaker: wren
w_photos_a.text: That's the Hales. Dana, Mark, and Ivy.

w_plants.speaker: wren
w_plants.text: The plants were Ivy's idea. She says they get lonely too.

w_plants_done.speaker: wren
w_plants_done.text: That's all of them. They look happier already.

w_sys_cameras.speaker: wren
w_sys_cameras.text: Cameras one, two, three and four. Online.

w_sys_heat.speaker: wren
w_sys_heat.text: Heating off. Temperature set to fifty degrees.

w_sys_nightmode.speaker: wren
w_sys_nightmode.text: Night Mode is active until seven A.M.

w_sys_power.speaker: wren
w_sys_power.text: Warning. Main power disconnected. Running on battery.

w_tv.speaker: wren
w_tv.text: I only get one channel. The lake camera. Ivy likes to watch the ice.

w_upstairs.speaker: wren
w_upstairs.text: You can sleep in the big bedroom upstairs. Ivy's room is at the end of the hall. Please don't wake her.

w_welcome.speaker: wren
w_welcome.text: Welcome to Hale House, Alex. I'm Wren. Come in, out of the cold.
